offer_level_fields.definition: Total nominal share quantity demanded in the bookbuild before any duplicate/ineligibility screen, exactly as the source states it.
Total nominal share quantity demanded after the source's stated screen (kabul edilen / elenmis / mukerrer ayiklanmis).
The offered-share quantity the source itself divided by to reach its published demand multiple; not necessarily the canonical shares_offered.
Total demand multiple as directly published by the source; never derived here.
Whether the source describes its total as filtered, unfiltered, or leaves it open.
Verbatim-grounded textual statement of the numerator, denominator and wording the source used.
Number of persons/applications reported on the demand side; never converted to an order or allocated count.
Number of investors/applications that actually received an allocation; never renamed to applicant count.
Filled only if the source explicitly reports a count of orders (emir adedi/sayisi); never derived from order quantity.
Which of applicant/allocated/order the source's single unlabelled investor count actually is.
The distribution rule applied per investor group (esit dagitim, oransal dagitim, mixtures), verbatim-grounded.
How the price was set and demand collected (sabit fiyatla talep toplama, fiyat araligi ile talep toplama, Borsa'da satis).
Legal name(s) of the lead intermediary/consortium leader(s), semicolon-separated, verbatim.
Whether a price-stabilisation (fiyat istikrari) undertaking was planned/disclosed pre-listing.
One disclosed price-stabilisation (fiyat istikrari) window, recorded in the unit the source itself uses. A source-stated "no stabilisation" is a real 0 with unit DAYS, never DATA_NOT_FOUND.
One disclosed lock-up undertaking binding the issuer on new share issuance, recorded in the unit the source itself uses.
One disclosed lock-up undertaking binding existing shareholders on sales, recorded in the unit the source itself uses.
The BIST market/segment the shares were admitted to at listing, verbatim.
The official KAP/BIST sector code for the issuer.
The official KAP/BIST sector label matching sector_kap_code, verbatim.
First calendar date of the demand-collection period, as disclosed.
Last calendar date of the demand-collection period, as disclosed.

source_hierarchy.rank_does_not_resolve_semantics: Rank breaks ties only between sources making the same claim under the same definition, scope and date. A semantic difference is recorded as SEMANTIC_DIFFERENCE, not resolved by hierarchy.

source_hierarchy.multi_source_rule: Each source stating the same field gets its own row; agreement is established by the validator, never by the collector discarding a row.

conflict_rules.SOURCES_CONFLICT: Same field, same semantic definition, same date, same scope, same offer universe, different value. Both rows recorded, same conflict_group_id, NO selection made.
conflict_rules.SCOPE_DIFFERENCE: Different scope (additional sale included vs excluded). Both rows recorded with their own scope_tag. Not a conflict.
conflict_rules.SEMANTIC_DIFFERENCE: Same field name, different definition. Both rows recorded; notes state each definition.
conflict_rules.SEMANTICALLY_AMBIGUOUS: Source wording resolvable into neither. Recorded with verbatim phrase, escalated, never guessed.
conflict_rules.SPEC_EDGE_CASE_UNRESOLVED: Structurally unusual offer whose scope cannot be bounded. Recorded and escalated; other fields proceed.
forbidden: selecting the more convenient/rounder/larger/smaller/more recent value
selecting the source that looks like the other 78 rows
silently promoting tier 5/6 to fill a tier 1-4 gap
deriving a multiple the source did not itself compute

per_document_absence.meaning: a per-document observation, not a per-field conclusion

conflict_rules.canonical_disagreement: Recorded and reported; never written back; resolution is a separate operator decision.

output_schema.content_charset_rule: Turkish characters inside CSV content preserved exactly; ASCII-folding and transliteration forbidden.

demand_category_csv.row_level_field_status_meaning: Describes the source record as a whole. Per-cell status lives in category_cell_status_csv. A data cell with no register entry is VALUE_RECORDED.

calibration.selection_rule: Members of HISTORICAL99_FROZEN_COHORT_V1 with membership_source = CANONICAL20_PROTECTED_INPUT, sorted by first_trading_date DESCENDING, tie-break ticker ASCENDING, first 5.
calibration.blindness: The collector receives ticker codes and this spec only. Canonical values, canonical file contents, and per-ticker row counts are withheld. Requesting the key before submitting B00 voids the calibration.

disclosed_residual_leak.what: Section 1.5 of the spec is visible to the collector and reports, per field, how many of the 20 dense tickers have a non-missing value (cohort-level aggregate).
disclosed_residual_leak.why_not_removed: Section 1.5 is the schema inventory this specification is required to carry.
disclosed_residual_leak.severity: WEAK_PRIOR_ONLY - names no ticker, gives no value, does not identify which 20 members are the 5
disclosed_residual_leak.binding_mitigation: The collector records what the source in front of it says and must not use the n20 counts as an expectation, in either direction. DATA_NOT_FOUND remains admissible only with a non-empty search_scope naming documents actually opened, which makes an unsearched DATA_NOT_FOUND detectable.

calibration.unscored_reason: Free-form Turkish prose in the canonical record; string equality is noise and semantic equivalence is not mechanical.
calibration.normalization_before_comparison: Strip thousands separators/whitespace, Turkish decimal comma to point, exact decimal string comparison after trailing-zero removal. No tolerance band. lead_broker compared as an order-insensitive name set.

checks: FORMAT: BOM, CRLF, delimiter, quoting, exact column count and order, exact header match
MEMBERSHIP: ticker set equals the frozen batch table entry for that batch_id
ENUMS: every enum-valued column drawn from the frozen lists; unrecognised value is FAIL, never a warning, never silently normalized

FIELD_NAME_CLOSURE: every field_name is one of the 22 (or company_name); unknown name is FAIL; price_stability_days, issuer_lockup_days or shareholder_lockup_days appearing as a collector-written field_name in a V2 row is FAIL
SENTINEL_DISCIPLINE: no empty cells, no N/A-family strings, no 0 under DATA_NOT_FOUND, non-empty search_scope on every DATA_NOT_FOUND row

DERIVATION: compute publication_timing_status, available_before_first_trade, verification_status, conflict_status; emit the 12-column projection and the 29-column derived file; assert the collector wrote none of these four
CONFLICT_INTEGRITY: every conflict/scope/semantic row shares conflict_group_id with at least one other row; no field carries both a conflict row and a lone unmarked resolved row

DUPLICATES (R4, replaces R2/R3's check 8 in full; second report added by R6 D1): three FAIL gates and two reports. FAIL - offer-level non-duration rows on (ticker, field_name, scope_tag, source_url); demand-category on (ticker, normalized_category, source_category_label, source_url); section 5.6 register on (ticker, normalized_category, source_category_label, field_name); rule code DUPLICATE_ROW_KEY. REPORT-ONLY - offer-level rows on fields 15/16/17, key (ticker, field_name, scope_tag, duration_start_reference, undertaking_scope, source_url), rule code DURATION_ROW_KEY_COLLISION, never gate-affecting, because section 2.1.1 item 2 makes two undertakings differing in duration and unit two correct rows and the key carries neither. REPORT-ONLY (R6 D1) - offer-level non-duration rows whose colliding key group satisfies all three conditions: every row carries a conflict_group_id other than NOT_APPLICABLE, those values are all identical, and every row carries a field_status from the conflict family (SOURCES_CONFLICT, SCOPE_DIFFERENCE, SEMANTIC_DIFFERENCE); rule code CONFLICT_FAMILY_ROW_KEY_COLLISION, never gate-affecting, because those rows are what section 4.1, section 4.2 and check 7 oblige the collector to produce. In every other case, including a group whose conflict_group_id is present on some rows and NOT_APPLICABLE, empty or absent on others, DUPLICATE_ROW_KEY remains a FAIL and the offer-level non-duration key is unchanged; recorded in section R6.1. The key is never extended with a free-text column. The structural fix (a typed undertaking identifier) is deferred to a genuine schema revision, recorded in section R4.2(c).
CANONICAL_IMMUTABILITY: sha256 of every frozen canonical Historical99 artifact and config schema TOML unchanged; any change is a hard STOP
CANONICAL_AGREEMENT: emit CANONICAL_DISAGREEMENT list for already-populated fields; report only, never a write-back

AGGREGATE_LEAF_GUARD AND PERCENTAGE_BASE_RECONSTRUCTION (R4, replaces R2/R3's check 11 in full): Branch A, additive fields (applicant_count, allocated_investor_count, order_count, planned_allocation_shares, demand_nominal, distributed_nominal) - leaf sum vs aggregate cell at the aggregate cell's own printed precision, unchanged from R2/R3, rule code AGGREGATE_LEAF_DIVERGENCE, violation and gate-affecting. Branch B, percentage fields (planned_allocation_pct/planned_allocation_shares, demand_share_pct/demand_nominal, distributed_pct/distributed_nominal) - each printed cell reconstructed as round(own nominal / base nominal * 100) at THAT cell's printed precision, ROUND_HALF_UP; the base row is the ticker's row that is AGGREGATE, is_aggregate TRUE and prints 100 in that same percentage field, identified structurally and never by category label; rule code PERCENTAGE_BASE_RECONSTRUCTION_MISMATCH, violation and gate-affecting. No base, an ambiguous base, an unusable base nominal or a non-numeric own nominal makes a cell uncheckable, counted, never passed. Never fix by dropping a row.

ARITHMETIC_CONSISTENCY (R3, filter-aware, replaces R2's check 12 in full): read total_demand_filter_status (field 5) before comparing. UNFILTERED designates demand_shares_unfiltered; FILTERED designates demand_shares_filtered; the non-designated numerator is NOT_APPLICABLE for this check and is counted under filter_status_excludes_numerator, never reported as a divergence and never as a pass. NOT_SPECIFIED and DATA_NOT_FOUND are undetermined: compare both, and if at least one pairing matches the published multiple the diverging pairing is ARITHMETIC_CONSISTENCY_UNDETERMINED_FILTER (report-only), while no matching pairing at all is ARITHMETIC_CONSISTENCY_DIVERGENCE (violation). NOT_APPLICABLE means C1: no multiple was published - if total_demand_multiple_value is nevertheless VALUE_RECORDED, or if FILTERED/UNFILTERED is asserted while it is not, raise FILTER_STATUS_MULTIPLE_CONTRADICTION, a FAIL. Where the designated numerator is not VALUE_RECORDED while the other is, raise ARITHMETIC_CONSISTENCY_NOT_COMPARABLE (report-only). Pairing by scope_tag, the comparison itself and the source-stated precision are unchanged from R2. REPORT_ONLY_NO_AUTOMATIC_CORRECTION governs correction, never severity: ARITHMETIC_CONSISTENCY_DIVERGENCE remains a gate-affecting violation.
OUTCOME_FIREWALL: assert no post-listing price/return/OHLCV value or column present; emit REALIZED_OUTCOME_READS = 0

DURATION_FIELD_INTEGRITY (R2): on fields 15/16/17 unit is DAYS/MONTHS/YEARS, duration_start_reference and undertaking_scope are not NOT_APPLICABLE, normalized_value is a plain decimal or DATA_NOT_FOUND; on every other field both R2 columns are NOT_APPLICABLE; more than one undertaking of a type for a ticker is a MULTIPLE_UNDERTAKINGS report item, informational, not a failure

CELL_STATUS_REGISTER_COMPLETENESS (R2): every demand-category data cell holding DATA_NOT_FOUND in a V2 batch has exactly one register row; every register row resolves to an existing category row and one of the 15 data field names; every register row with field_status DATA_NOT_FOUND has a non-empty, non-generic search_scope; a missing register row is FAIL. Applies only to spec_version V2 rows
MANIFEST: sha256 of all batch CSVs; row counts derived from the actual files, never from a hardcoded historical constant
REPORT: per-batch validation JSON in the existing batch_0N_validation.json shape, including scope_guards and protected_hashes, with status PASS / PASS_WITH_WARNINGS / FAIL

collector_prohibitions: Never modify any existing repository file; output only under work/pretrade_extension/
Never change f3 or any total-demand column
Never read or record a post-listing outcome
Never average, pick, or rank away a conflict
Never write a value the source does not state, including when it seems obviously implied or when it follows arithmetically
Never treat collection as admission into a feature set or model
Never collect batches ahead of validation
When uncertain, do not guess: record the ambiguity with its verbatim phrase and escalate

Never write a script-derived field (R2): publication_timing_status, available_before_first_trade, verification_status, conflict_status, total_demand_multiple_origin, price_stability_days, issuer_lockup_days, shareholder_lockup_days
Never convert a duration into another unit (R2): record the magnitude and the unit the source printed

prohibition_5_never_write_an_unstated_va.note: The R1-era gap was not that this prohibition was too strict; it was that the schema gave the collector nowhere to put what the source actually said, leaving silence as the only compliant answer. R2 widens what can be recorded, never what may be invented.

d1_check_11.what: Section 8 check 11's percentage branch is replaced by per-cell reconstruction from the cell's own nominal and the ticker's percentage base; the additive branch is unchanged.
d1_check_11.why: The replaced comparison, round(a)+round(b) versus round(a+b), is one the source never asserts. Measured over B00_codex_r2..B04: 4 divergences in 13 percentage-family comparisons, 0 in 24 additive ones, every divergence exactly one unit in the last place and reproducible from the delivered bytes.
d1_check_11.base_row_rule: Per (batch_id, ticker, percentage field): the row with category_level AGGREGATE, is_aggregate TRUE, printing a plain decimal equal to 100 in that same percentage field. Never identified by category label.
d1_check_11.base_rule_measured: Exactly one base row in 57 of 57 (ticker, percentage field) groups holding any numeric cell; 0 with none; 0 ambiguous; all 57 AGGREGATE/TRUE.

coverage_delta.coverage_lost_identity: B00_codex_r2 ALBTN, Yurt Disi Yatirimci / - Kurumsal Yatirimci, distributed_pct 0.00 with distributed_nominal DATA_NOT_FOUND; becomes uncheckable, never passed.

d1_check_11.dissolves_is_not_waived: In each case a comparison the source never asserted is replaced by one it does assert, which the delivered bytes satisfy exactly. No finding is reclassified as an acceptable defect.
d1_check_11.catch_rate_hypothesis: 0 catches in 187 checked cells to date; roughly 450 further percentage cells over B05..B16; at a 0.5% transcription-error rate the expected yield is 1 to 2 catches. Principal near-term value is removing an estimated 8 to 10 forecast false firings and the 206-cell coverage gain.

d2_check_8.what: Section 8 check 8's duration clause is downgraded to a report-only DURATION_ROW_KEY_COLLISION; its other three keys stay FAIL gates.
d2_check_8.why: Coded literally the duration clause produces 11 FAILs across B01, B02 and B04, every one on shareholder_lockup_undertaking and every one on a row pattern section 2.1.1 item 2 declares correct. Measured true-positive rate 0 in 101 duration rows; measured excess on the other three keys 0.
d2_check_8.register_gate_is_load_bearing: Section 5.6 binding rule 1 ('two rows for one cell is a FAIL (section 8 check 8)') depends on the register gate and is preserved by leaving it untouched.

contradiction_status.obligation_conflict: RESOLVED - section 2.1.1 item 2 and check 8 can now both be satisfied by the same 11 rows, because a report asserts nothing about correctness.
contradiction_status.residual_1: DESCRIPTIVE - the check is still titled Duplicates and still computes a key over rows that are not duplicates.
contradiction_status.residual_2: LOST GATE - a genuine duplicate duration row is now reported, not gated. Measured exposure 0 in 101 rows.

d2_check_8.forbidden_interim_fix: Extending the key with page_or_section, verbatim_source_phrase or any other free-text column, notwithstanding that + page_or_section + normalized_value + unit measures 0 residual collisions on 101 rows: a FAIL gate must not depend on a collector's free-text transcription choice, and the 0 is fitted to four batches.
d2_check_8.deferred_structural_fix: A typed undertaking identifier (undertaking_ordinal per (ticker, field_name, source_url), or the source clause identifier as a typed field). Requires a 27th column, a third arm in check 1's column-count resolution, a new spec_version and therefore a fork of the section 7.4 item 4 merge key, a new collector obligation and the first reissue of COLLECTOR_INSTRUCTION.md, and a back-fill or coexistence rule for the 101 delivered duration rows.
